defaults.instructions:
1. This is a video series that follows a group of friends/content creators competitive Fantasy Football league. The league takes place during an individual NFL season. There is a playoff tournament at the end of each "season", ultimately resulting in a championship winner. There is also an Ultimate Loser of each season, who faces a special punishment before the start of the following season. Each new season starts fresh, coinciding with the start of the next NFL season. The inaugural season took place during the 2024-25 NFL season.
2. Reference a generic Fantasy Football PPR ruleset to understand how the game is played.
3. The narrative importance should be placed primarily on the "Team Owners" rather than the NFL athletes. For example, if noting that NFL athlete Puka Nacua is injured during Week 1, it is important to note who is the Team Owner with Puka Nacua on their team.
4. Team names (e.g. "StevenSwagal") may change week-to-week but Team Owner (e.g. "Tom") should remain static. Therefore, it is best to use the Team Owner name rather than the Team name in all notes.
5. Track as many details of who wins head-to-head matchups (including the score) each week, but note that the full details of every matchup are not always available for a given week due to how the videos are selectively edited.
6. Always make note of mentioned injuries, trades, and waiver wire actions.
7. Be concise in the note-taking; wordiness is not a virtue.
8. Make note of any "items requiring review" for each episode so that the human (me) can review your uncertainties and potentially add more guidance.

episode.title: Week 1 Changed The Flock League Forever

evidence.details: Narration identifies Nathan's matchup against Tom; the Week 1 scoreboard shows Nathan at 118.98 and Tom's displayed team at 129.58.
Final matchup board again shows Nathan at 118.98 versus the Tom-linked displayed account at 129.58.

events.summary: Puka Nacua, rostered by Nathan, was listed out during the Rams game in Week 1.

evidence.details: Narrator says Nacua was listed out; the matchup display shows P. Nacua on Nathan's side marked out.
Earlier breaking-news graphic reads “PLACED ON INJURED RESERVE — PUKA NACUA.”

events.summary: Bush defeated Sal in Week 1; the final matchup board shows 118.84–101.55.

evidence.details: Sal says he started Xavier Worthy against Corey/Bush; the final player panel shows Worthy at 20.80 points.
Final matchup board lists Bush's team at 118.84 versus Sal's “Sorry Corey” team at 101.55.

events.summary: Danny defeated Zach in Week 1. Supplied displays conflict on the exact final score.

evidence.details: Narration congratulates Danny on beating Zach and says Danny's kicker and defense combined for 46 points; the displayed matchup gives 141.56–118.46.
Final board shows Danny's team at 141.36 over a partially unreadable opponent at 119.46.

events.summary: Mason defeated Thomas in Week 1, but supplied displays conflict on the exact score.

evidence.details: Mason says he is 1-0; standings list Mason at 1-0 with 126.42 PF and 93.08 PA, reversed for Thomas.
Final board lists Mason at 106.42 versus Thomas at 93.69.

events.summary: Christian McCaffrey was declared inactive before Monday Night Football while in Thomas's lineup against Mason.

evidence.details: Narration states McCaffrey was labeled inactive and that Thomas had him in his lineup for the Mason matchup.

events.summary: Austin defeated an opponent identified by narration as Joe; the final board instead associates the losing team label with @averyhuffman. Exact score also differs slightly across supplied displays.

evidence.details: Speaker says he lost to Austin; the display shows the Joe-labeled team at 124.48 versus Austin's team at 141.82.
Final board shows Austin at 141.82 over @averyhuffman / “flockfantasy.com/joe” at 124.44.

events.summary: Badake defeated an opponent identified in narration as Joe, though the supplied score and opponent identification conflict with other Week 1 material.

facts.name: Badake claim
facts.value: Led the league in Week 1 scoring with 148 points

evidence.details: Badake says he faced Joe, had the league's top Week 1 score, and the displayed matchup shows 148.39–99.22.
Final board shows Badake at 141.30 over @GreenMeansMoney at 90.22.

events.summary: Tee Higgins was reported doubtful for Week 1 with a hamstring injury.

evidence.details: Speaker and on-screen headline state that Higgins was doubtful for Week 1 with a hamstring injury.

events.summary: Avery's offer to send Kenneth Walker for Rhamondre Stevenson and Austin Ekeler was not accepted.

evidence.details: Trade graphic lists Rhamondre Stevenson and Austin Ekeler to Avery's side and Kenneth Walker from averyhuffman.
Speaker says he offered the package for Walker and did not receive a counter.

events.summary: Badake put Saquon Barkley and A.J. Brown on the trade block; an offer of Ja'Marr Chase and Jaylen Waddle for them was not completed, and Badake countered with Calvin Ridley and DJ Moore for Chase.

facts.name: unaccepted offer to Badake
facts.value: Ja'Marr Chase and Jaylen Waddle for Saquon Barkley and A.J. Brown

facts.name: Badake counteroffer
facts.value: Calvin Ridley and DJ Moore for Ja'Marr Chase

evidence.details: Badake's trade-block notification and the later counteroffer are shown and discussed.

events.summary: Mason offered Rhamondre Stevenson and Caleb Williams for James Cook; acceptance was not established.

evidence.details: Recipient says they received Mason's offer of Rhamondre Stevenson and Caleb Williams for James Cook.

events.summary: Mason started Caleb Williams over Justin Fields in Week 1.

evidence.details: Mason says the league chat convinced him to go with Caleb over Fields.

events.summary: Mason added Isaac Guerendo and dropped Isaiah Davis in a free-agent transaction.

evidence.details: Transaction graphic states that MasonDodd added Isaac Guerendo and dropped Isaiah Davis.
